facts.text: Sir Alfred, the undead knight, lies incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound's lower level and may yet harm the Free Goblin Society goblins now settling in the mound's upper rooms.
Why does Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight with a great sword, roam the Barrow Mound?
